What happens when you eat sesame seeds (Nuvvulu) and jaggery (Bellam) on an empty stomach? Can this traditional food combination help support nerve health and reduce weakness? In this informative video, Dr. Aditya Ranganath discusses the nutritional benefits of sesame seeds and jaggery, nerve weakness symptoms, and healthy eating habits.

Discover the potential health benefits of sesame seeds, including their protein, healthy fats, calcium, magnesium, and other essential nutrients. Learn about the nutritional value of jaggery and the importance of a balanced diet for maintaining healthy nerves and overall wellness.
